outcome.answer: Yes. AMuFC adaptively decides whether visual evidence is useful for a claim, rather than assuming images always improve verification; the paper reports that indiscriminate visual evidence can reduce accuracy [7]. VILLAIN is a broader image-text claim fact-checking system: it analyzes textual and visual evidence and produces a verification verdict, but its abstract does not describe a separate decision about whether the image helps [1]. MIC focuses on identifying and explaining inconsistencies between an image and its paired claim, especially for AI-generated images [4].
